Offer is here an offering made to God for a thanksgiving, the purpose the verse states; the act bears on the thanks, which the verse names.

Offered is here the burnt offerings the king offered at the house of the Lord, among the things that took the breath from the queen of Sheba; the outward act bears on her wonder, named by another word of the verse.
